target_customer: Carbon intensive enterprises that must measure, report and cut emissions
problem: Companies manage carbon with spreadsheets, siloed teams and expensive consultants and lack a way to price emissions and find cost effective reductions.
business_model: Enterprise SaaS subscription plus climate advisory services
product_category: Carbon management and ESG compliance software

founders.name: Maria Fujihara
founders.background_notes: YC page and PRWeb release: about 14 years in sustainability, advisor to Project Drawdown, Singularity University alumna. CEO changed later; sinai.com lists Jess Waldeck as CEO.

founders.name: Alain Rodriguez
founders.background_notes: From the October 2020 PRWeb seed release.

technical_complexity.rationale: Emissions factor databases, supplier data collection and decarbonization modelling need domain expertise on top of normal enterprise software.

defensibility.rationale: Enterprise integrations and emissions data lock in customers, but GHG Protocol based accounting was being copied by many entrants.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found; many carbon accounting rivals emerged after 2020.

market_need_then: The October 2020 release says customers used spreadsheets and consultants, and named early customers Siemens Brasil, ArcelorMittal Brasil and BRK Ambiental.

brand_strength.rationale: Short exact .com, but the name also means Mount Sinai and Sinai Peninsula, and no brand press or community was found.

outcome_analysis: SINAI raised about 36M to 37M USD across a seed, a 10M seed and a 22M Series A led by Energize Ventures in 2022, riding climate disclosure rules. It is still active and expanding to the Middle East under a new CEO, so it looks like a funded but contested carbon software player.
notes: Seed rounds: one article calls about 4M a pre-seed; treated as the same 3.8M seed. Reuters total of 37M comes via search summary. Education not found. Competitors: the 2020 release names none, only spreadsheets and consultants; Persefoni and Watershed appear only in undated comparisons, so the list is empty. Name origin not found. Founder CEO change from Fujihara to Waldeck seen on company site.
